statement:
Research objective: Measure efficiency and minutes of players above 30 minutes per game on the second night of back-to-backs.

Data: 2026-27 NBA regular season from 2026-10-20 to 2027-01-31 (development period), plus 2022-23 to 2024-25 seasons. The 2025-26 season is not provided. Fields: play-by-play actions (actionType, subType, clock, period, teamId, personId, scoreHome/scoreAway, shotDistance, xLegacy/yLegacy, shotResult, shotValue, description); rotation intervals per player (in_time, out_time, player_pts, pt_diff); box-score summary (game date, officials, attendance, national TV broadcaster, inactive players, line score).
Unit of analysis to consider: player second-night games (about 2133 expected in the development period).
What would count as a meaningful finding: A per-player efficiency change with a credible interval on second nights.
Validation: claims are tested on games from 2027-01-31 to 2027-04-12, which are sealed until every claim is registered. Planned approach: Replicate the pooled estimate on validation games.

Register at most three claims. Each claim needs an estimand, a direction, a pre-specified test with a pass rule, and an analysis script that runs unchanged on the validation data.
permitted_memory: full history (all 384 records); no record uses 2026-27 data
